definitions.full: H7060. qamel [ קָמֵל ] verb be decayed (Syriac be mouldy, decay ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular קָמַ֑ל Isa 33:9 Lebanon mouldereth ; 3 plural קָמַ֑לוּ 19:6 (of וָסוּף קָנֶה ).
